'''Jeek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] and the twin brother of [[Teek (Neimoidian)|Teek]]. Both brothers proudly claimed themselves as tier-six inventors of [[Research Corps Eight]] of the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]], a rare feat for non-Humans in the xenophobic Empire. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the two brothers traveled to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where stationed at two different Imperial outposts each of them asked the same Imperial passerby to help with testing of new [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="TOR" />
